title: Stress & Resilience
text:
Welcome to this module on understanding and managing stress, and building resilience as a student.






Learning Objectives




Define stress and resilience
Identify common sources of stress among students
Learn strategies to build resilience and manage stress effectively






Stress is the body’s response to any demand or challenge. While some stress can be motivating, chronic or overwhelming stress can negatively affect your well-being.








Tip



Reflect: Think of a recent stressful experience. How did your body react? What thoughts did you have?






Resilience is the ability to bounce back from challenges. It involves adaptability, emotional strength, and support systems.



Resilience infographic








Warning



Try This: List 3 personal strengths that help you manage stress.









Avoiding all stress

Being unaffected by emotions

Adapting to challenges ✓






In this module, you learned: - The definition and effects of stress - The concept of resilience and how it supports well-being - Tips and reflections to help strengthen your own resilience
